English HOME Menu and System Settings for Japanese 3DS consoles, without a region change.

This is the first release of this fork of [imphuochuynh/luma-jpn-english](https://github.com/imphuochuynh/luma-jpn-english). The translations are the same as in the original; this release is about making the tool easier and safer to use.

### What's new

- **One-step dumping.** A GodMode9 script copies and decrypts the files the tool needs, so you no longer have to find and copy them by hand.
- **Double-click building.** `build.bat` (Windows) and `build.command` (macOS) find Python and your dumps folder for you.
- **Safer builds.** If any check fails, nothing is written. The Windows `dumps\*.app` command works now, and a few crashes are fixed.
- **Cleaner output.** The build messages are short and never show your user name, so they're safe to paste into an issue. Lines that may show on two lines are listed in `out/long-lines.txt`.
- **A rewritten guide** with simpler steps, help with checking and updating Luma3DS and GodMode9, and how to undo everything on the console itself.

### How to use it

Download **3ds-jpn-english-v1.1.zip** below and follow the [README](https://github.com/ilex-labs/3ds-jpn-english#readme). You'll need Luma3DS v13.4 or newer, GodMode9 v2.2.3 or newer, and Python 3.8 or newer.

Tested on Japanese New 3DS, New 3DS LL and New 2DS LL consoles.

This download contains no Nintendo files. You copy the original files from your own console, and the tool makes the English versions from them.

The full list of changes is under [Changes from upstream](https://github.com/ilex-labs/3ds-jpn-english#changes-from-upstream).
